text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Well now. Good work today, me! All that's 
left is to change, take a nice bath, and 
do a princess dive into bed—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Oh goodness, this won't do! I must read 
the shojo manga I borrowed from 
Scarlet-san!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Umm... didn't you say it was a story about 
a prince...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —Mhm, mhm... I see!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This prince is quite something too, isn't 
he? He's pulling all sorts of prince moves 
I've never seen before!
Sunday. While strolling through town—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh noooooo!!!! I'm late, I'm late, I'm so 
laaaate!!!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Kyaaaaaaa!!!! Please get out of the 
waaaaay!!!!

...I barely managed to dodge Kawakami 
Princess charging right at me.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—Oh dear? How very strange... This isn't 
how things went in my image training...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I thought this was the part where you'd 
catch me, start waltzing, and ask, 'Are 
you all right?'...
choice_data_list: What on earth are you talking about...?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
To tell the truth, I had quite a bit of 
culture shock last night over the most 
unexpected thing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I heard 'prince', all I could 
picture was the legendary trainer from 
PreFie, but~...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The prince I saw yesterday possessed 
enough arm strength to effortlessly scoop 
the princess into his arms!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"A true prince certainly ought to have 
enough strength to lift a truck or two, 
wouldn't you say!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
And above all, legs that can always make 
it in time to save a princess in peril! I 
had no idea a prince could possess legs 
capable of rivaling an Umamusume...!

...It seems she learned some new 
information about a prince and has wildly 
misunderstood something.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
By all means! I would simply love to see 
your princely moves, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still, there seem to be many different 
kinds of 'prince-like moves,' don't there? 
I wonder which one would be best...
choice_data_list:
...How about something that tests your 
spirit rather than your body?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Mmh, in that case~... umm~...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is it! Trainer, I... would love to 
experience a "kabedon"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! Well, it might be a little dangerous 
around here, so let's move somewhere else!
...Dangerous? A kabedon?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Alright! If you please! Show us the 
Prince-style Wallbuster!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! A kabedon is a heated battle between 
a prince and a princess! The one who 
corners the other against the wall is the 
victor, isn't that right?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I shall gracefully parry Trainer's fierce 
push with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, come at me! If you won't make a move, 
then I shall!

...After that. I somehow survived the 
peril of being "kabedon"-ed... and in any 
case, made it home safely, totally worn 
out.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Unconventional, you say? Hmm, I wonder 
what would be good~..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, in that case, I want to try the one 
where the princess takes the prince's hand 
and escapes from their pursuers!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The prince is in a pinch... And then the 
princess appears and sweeps him away! A 
prince and princess rely on one another, 
you see!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now, please take my hand! I'm reeling in a 
prince in one fell swoop~!

—And so, until Kawakami Princess was 
satisfied with her situational image 
training, I was repeatedly and thoroughly 
flipped over her shoulder.
